graph.library.lfo.description: Reusable bipolar low-frequency modulation source built from the LFO primitive and a published Value output.
graph.library.polySine.description: Clear polyphonic sine instrument with editable voice allocation, oscillator, ADSR, gain and voice filter stages.
graph.library.reverbRack.description: Compact stereo room processor whose complete internal Graph and control surface can be inspected or reused.
graph.library.vocalStrip.description: Focused vocal channel combining compression and tonal shaping in an editable stereo Graph.
graph.library.cleanChannel.description: Transparent stereo channel with DC removal, high-pass filtering, gentle compression, tone and output gain.
graph.library.warmDrive.description: Warm saturation chain with drive, resonant filtering, peak control and output trim.
graph.library.echoSpace.description: Musical stereo delay followed by a subtle room stage for a coherent spatial effect.
graph.library.stereoFinisher.description: Stereo finishing chain with tone, width, gentle compression, peak safety and spectrum visualization.
graph.library.parallelDrive.description: Editable dry/wet parallel distortion topology built with a drive branch, trim and Audio Sum.
graph.library.polyPad.description: Slow polyphonic pad with an editable oscillator, long ADSR, voice filter, stereo width and reverb chain.
graph.library.polyBass.description: Compact polyphonic bass with a short envelope, resonant filtering, drive and dynamics control.
graph.library.arpMotion.description: MIDI performance Graph combining arpeggiation, octave transposition and velocity shaping.
graph.library.noteShaper.description: MIDI note-range and velocity conditioning Graph for reusable keyboard zones and performance control.
graph.library.unipolarLfo.description: LFO remapped to a 0–1 range with an inline value monitor and a published Value output.
graph.library.audioFollower.description: Stereo audio envelope follower exposed as a reusable modulation Value with live monitoring.
graph.library.scopeSuite.description: Transparent analysis Graph combining waveform, spectrum and level probes before the stereo output.
graph.library.drumPunch.description: Punch-oriented drum chain with rumble removal, firm compression, light drive, peak control and output trim.
graph.library.wideEcho.description: Wide filtered echo combining delay, stereo expansion and high-frequency damping in an editable Graph.
graph.library.darkRoom.description: Dark spatial processor with resonant filtering, a large room and gentle tonal shaping.
graph.library.monoFocus.description: Stereo-to-mono utility with transparent level monitoring and a reusable typed stereo contract.
graph.library.masterGuard.description: Master safety chain with DC removal, subsonic filtering, gentle compression, peak clipping and level monitoring.
graph.library.tremolo.description: Audio tremolo built from a bipolar LFO, range mapping and a modulated Gain primitive.
graph.library.autoPan.description: Stereo auto-pan whose editable LFO directly modulates the Pan primitive.
graph.library.dynamicFilter.description: Envelope-controlled low-pass filter whose audio follower is mapped to cutoff in real time.
graph.library.octaveUp.description: Minimal reusable MIDI Graph that transposes incoming notes by one octave.
graph.library.bassZone.description: Low keyboard zone with note filtering and velocity conditioning for layered instruments.
graph.library.polyPluck.description: Short polyphonic pluck with a shaped oscillator, fast ADSR, resonant voice filter and compact echo.
graph.library.polyLead.description: Driven polyphonic lead with a saw oscillator, expressive ADSR, resonant filtering and stereo delay.
graph.library.polyKeys.description: Complete playable keys example with editable voice allocation, oscillator, ADSR, resonant filter, compression, stereo imaging and live spectrum.
graph.library.ambientGlass.description: Complete ambient instrument with a slow envelope, resonant voice filter, stereo delay, large reverb, width control and live spectrum.
graph.library.electricOrgan.description: Complete electric organ example with sustained polyphony, tone filtering, drive, compression, stereo width and output metering.
graph.library.percussiveBell.description: Complete percussive bell instrument with a short transient envelope, resonant filter, echo, reverb and live spectrum.

language.label: Language
node.chorus.description: Thickens the sound with slightly delayed, modulated copies: body and stereo width.
node.flanger.description: A very short swept delay fed back on itself: the seventies jet sweep.
node.phaser.description: Six all-pass stages swept by an LFO: notches that turn through the spectrum.
node.bitcrusher.description: Fewer bits and a lower sample rate: rough, lo-fi digital sound.
node.multiFilter.description: Resonant low-pass, high-pass, band-pass or notch filter with input drive.
node.autoFilter.description: A resonant low-pass whose cutoff an LFO sweeps: wah, wobble.
node.eqThree.description: Lows, mids and highs, with both crossover frequencies adjustable.
node.limiter.description: Raises the level and keeps peaks under the ceiling.
node.gate.description: Mutes what falls under the threshold: cleans up noise, shortens tails.
node.transientShaper.description: More or less attack and sustain: adds punch or softens a hit.
node.pingPong.description: Echoes bouncing between left and right.
node.monoToStereo.description: A mono signal on both sides, placed in the stereo field by the pan.
node.stereoToMono.description: Both sides folded into one: their average, or leaning to one side with the balance.
node.tremoloPan.description: The level swings with an LFO; with spread, left and right swing apart (auto-pan).
node.eqPro.description: 8-band parametric equaliser: bells, shelves, low and high cuts up to 48 dB/oct, notch, band-pass and tilt, with the spectrum before and after.
node.ampSim.description: Amp simulator: noise gate, pedal (boost, overdrive, fuzz), valve preamp, passive tone stack (bass, middle, treble), power stage with sag, presence and depth; eight models, from American clean to modern high gain and bass amps. Put Cabinet and microphone after it.
node.cabSim.description: A guitar or bass cabinet taken by one or two microphones: the cabinet (1x12 open back to 8x10 bass), each microphone's type, where it points on the speaker (centre or edge), its distance and angle, the blend of the two, their phase, the room.
node.micSim.description: The sound as a microphone would take it: dynamic, condenser, ribbon, valve, broadcast, lavalier, or telephone, megaphone, old radio, walkie-talkie; its distance (proximity effect), angle and pattern, its preamp pushed, the room.
node.halo.description: A reverb of characters: ten algorithms (concert hall, bright hall, plate, room, chamber, random space, chorus space, ambience, sanctuary, nonlinear) in three colours (1970s, 1980s, now); the bass's own decay, modulation, diffusion, predelay free or synced to the tempo.
node.tranche.description: A track's channel strip in one module: gate, equaliser (low cut, low shelf, two bells, high shelf, high cut), compressor, transients, exciter, width; an assistant listens to the track and suggests the equalising and the compression.
node.finition.description: Mastering in one module: equaliser, three-band dynamics, exciter and stereo image per band, a look-ahead maximizer; an assistant listens to the song and sets the gain to reach the loudness aimed at (streaming, CD, radio…).
node.multibandPro.description: Dynamics on four bands: each compressed, expanded (like a gate), raised or burst, its threshold, ratio, range, times, knee, gain; the crossovers and thresholds dragged on the spectrum.
node.velours.description: Finds the resonances that stand out of the spectrum and calms them, only while they ring: depth, sharpness, selectivity, attack, release, focus, soft or hard mode, and hearing what is taken away.
node.patine.description: The sound made old: noise (record, tape, mains), the tape's wobble, distortion, digital wear, a small room, magnetic tape and its dropouts; a magnitude over them all, tone, width and mix.
node.sonometre.description: Measures loudness (LUFS): momentary, short-term, integrated, loudness range, true peak, PLR, and their history, against a target (streaming, Apple Music, radio, TV, CD). The sound passes unchanged.
node.pression.description: Upward and downward compression on three bands: the loud held, the quiet raised, all at once. Depth, time, upward and downward amounts, each band's gain; thresholds and ratios set by dragging the bars.
node.fournaise.description: Analog saturation in five characters (tape, console, class A, valve, pentode): drive, tone, low cut (with its thump), high cut, punish (+20 dB), automatic level, oversampling.
node.echoBande.description: A tape echo: three playback heads in twelve modes, a spring reverb, an intensity that can run away, wow and flutter, the tape's wear, the echoes' bass and treble, the time free or synced to the tempo.
node.reverbPro.description: Studio reverb: a network of sixteen delays, the space, the decay set apart in the lows, mids and highs (drag the curve), a pre-delay free or in time, the distance, brightness, character, early reflections, the cuts after it, ducking and freeze.
node.limiterPro.description: Mastering limiter: lookahead, eight styles, true peak (peaks between samples), stereo link for transients and release, dither with noise shaping, and loudness metering (LUFS) beside the gain reduction history.
node.filterPro.description: Four filters (low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch, peak, comb; 12 to 48 dB/oct, drive, stereo spread) in series, in parallel or in pairs, moved by two LFOs, an envelope follower and four free modulations; drag a source onto a cutoff to modulate it.
node.compPro.description: Studio compressor: eight styles (Clean, Classic, Opto, Vocal, Mastering, Bus, Punch, Pumping), knee, range, attack, release (automatic or not), hold, lookahead, a filtered detector (high and low pass, to audition), stereo link or mid/side, automatic makeup and a mix for parallel compression.
node.spectrometer.description: Analyses the sound without changing it: a large spectrum curve with its peaks held, and a scrolling waterfall (the spectrum over time).
graph.library.spectrometer.description: A spectrometer to put on a track or the master: spectrum curve, held peaks and waterfall. The sound passes untouched.
node.vocoder.description: Makes a sound speak with the voice coming in: the voice split into bands shapes a carrier — noise, saws on a note, saws that follow the voice's pitch, or another track's sound wired into its sidechain input. Bands, range, formants, attack, release, sibilants, stereo spread.
node.deEsser.description: Tames a voice's loud 's' and 'sh' sounds, only when they pass the threshold: frequency, threshold, range, release, reduction of the band alone or of the whole sound, high-pass or band detection, and hearing what the detector hears.
node.tuner.description: Shows the note played and how far it is from the true note, with a needle or a strobe; the reference A is adjustable. The sound passes untouched, or is muted while tuning.
node.harmonie.description: Shifts a sound's pitch and adds a second voice to it: two voices, each with its interval (two octaves either way), fine tuning, level and place; the dry sound, an echo, three ways of working (smooth, voice that keeps its formants, percussive).
node.justesse.description: Brings a voice onto the true notes of the chosen key and scale, gently or at once (the robot effect at zero speed): retune speed, amount, humanize that lets held notes live, transpose, voice range, sensitivity.
node.empreinte.description: A convolution reverb: the response of a real place, loaded from a file (up to eight seconds), or one of the ten built-in spaces (room, studio, halls, cathedral, plate, spring, echo chamber, tunnel, cave). Length, reverse, pre-delay, early and tail levels, low cut, high cut, width.
node.givre.description: Freezes the sound in its spectrum and makes it last, or blurs it in time and across frequencies: freeze, blur, frequency smear, spectral shift, phase scatter, colour, freeze retriggered in time.
node.grains.description: An echo made of grains: the delayed sound cut into small pieces played back at another pitch, scattered in time and space, sometimes backwards. Time (or note value), feedback, pitch, random pitch, spray, density, grain size, buffer freeze.
node.saccade.description: Stutters in time: at a chosen moment of each bar, a piece of the sound repeats on a grid (1/32 to 1/4), more or less often, lower and lower or softer and softer, sometimes backwards; mixed with the sound, in its place or alone. A button repeats at once.
node.boucleur.description: Records what comes in and plays it back as a loop, then layers new takes over it: record, play, overdub, stop, clear; free length or bars locked to the tempo, start on the bar, half or double speed, reverse.
node.pompe.description: Pumps the volume in time without a compressor: a curve (eight shapes, or drawn with sixteen points) played on every beat or on every hit of the track wired into its sidechain input. Depth, curve, hold at the bottom, phase, stereo offset, smoothing.
node.decaleur.description: Shifts every frequency of the sound by the same number of hertz (not by an interval): metallic sounds, beatings, endless spirals with feedback. Shift, fine, stereo spread, LFO, one sideband, both, or opposite sides.
node.anneau.description: Multiplies the sound by a wave: bells, robot voices, very fast tremolo. Frequency, wave shape, ring or amplitude modulation, drive, LFO (rate, depth in octaves, stereo phase), input low cut.
node.rotor.description: A rotating speaker cabinet: the treble horn and the bass drum spin, slowly or fast, and each speeds up at its own pace. Speeds, acceleration, horn / drum balance, Doppler, preamp drive, crossover, mic spread, room.
node.resonateurs.description: Five tuned resonators the sound makes sing: a root note and four intervals (a chord), each with its level; decay, colour, width, strings, plucked or metal.
node.corps.description: Makes the sound resonate in an object: beam, marimba, string, membrane, plate, pipe or tube. Tune, decay, material, inharmonicity, listening position, width, input low cut.
node.peigne.description: A tuned comb filter: the sound fed through a short delay, as a loop or forward, carves or rings a series of harmonics. Frequency, feedback (negative: odd harmonics), damping, stereo spread, LFO.
node.utilitaire.description: A track's small settings in one place: gain, pan, stereo width, mono bass, polarity of each side, channels (stereo, left, right, swapped, mono), DC filter, a delay to align, mute.
node.stereoscope.description: Shows the sound's stereo image: the left-right cloud (goniometer), the phase correlation over time and per band (lows, mids, highs), the balance and the width. The sound passes untouched.
node.arpege.description: Plays the held notes one after another in time: up, down, up and down, in the order played, at random, as a chord, converging or diverging; over one to four octaves, at the chosen step, with swing, gate, velocity as played, fixed or accented, latch.
node.accords.description: Turns a note into a chord: major, minor, fifth, sus, sevenths, ninths, octaves or six intervals of your own; inversion, open voicing, added notes' velocity, notes strummed up or down, or chords that follow a scale.
node.gamme.description: Brings the notes played into a key and a scale: to the nearest, above, below, or by removing those outside it; transposition in semitones or in degrees of the scale.
node.echoNotes.description: Repeats each note like an echo, as notes: at the chosen time or note value, as many times as wanted, each echo softer and, if wanted, higher or lower.
node.alea.description: Makes the playing human or unpredictable: a little random delay, varying velocities, notes that do not always play, or that change pitch now and then.
node.duree.description: Gives the notes the chosen length, whatever was played: a fixed time, a note value, a stretched length, or until the next note (legato).
node.sequenceur.description: A sixteen-step sequencer: each step on or off, its note, velocity and length; played while a key is held (and transposed by it) or with the transport; step, swing, direction (forward, backward, ping-pong, random).
node.roulement.description: Repeats a note while it is held, at a note value or a free rate: snare rolls, fast hi-hats; hit length, velocity rising or falling.
node.drumRack.description: A pad rack: on each pad, any instrument with its own effects, played by its key; level, pan, mute, solo and choke group per pad.
node.modLfo.description: A low-frequency oscillator: a shape that cycles, free or on the tempo, restarted by notes if asked.
node.modSteps.description: A step sequence of values, one step per note value of the tempo, or at its own rate.
node.modRandom.description: A new random value each cycle (sample and hold), smoothed if asked.
node.modAdsr.description: An envelope the track's notes open and close: attack, decay, sustain, release.
node.modNote.description: The last note played: its key around a root, its velocity, or whether a key is held.
node.modExpression.description: The modulation wheel, aftertouch, pitch bend or any controller of the track.
node.modMacro.description: One knob that moves many: turn it, or automate it.
node.modButton.description: A switch: on, it moves its knobs by their whole amount; off, not at all.
node.modMath.description: Two values combined: mixed, added, multiplied, the lower, the higher… Plug modulators into A and B.
node.modFollower.description: How loud its device sounds, as a value: the louder, the more it moves its knobs.
